evidence.claim: Picabo Street won Olympic gold in Super-G (1998 Nagano) and silver in downhill (1994 Lillehammer), alongside consecutive World Cup Downhill season titles (1995, 1996), 9 World Cup downhill wins, and 3 World Championship medals.
Picabo Street retired in 2002 after the Salt Lake City Games and was inducted into the National Ski Hall of Fame (2004) and the USOPC Hall of Fame (2009).

Street co-founded the Picabo Street Academy in Park City, Utah, for elite student-athletes (partnered with Stifel, Hydro Flask, Xfinity, and Kappa) and operates the Street of Dreams Foundation, while hosting luxury travel for US Ski & Snowboard's Crest Club.
Street debuted as a sports commentator for NBC Sports at the Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Winter Games, reporting on women's alpine events at Cortina d'Ampezzo.
On September 9-10, 2026, Picabo Street was officially nominated by shareholder Oasis Management for the Vail Resorts Board of Directors.
